title: Brand Standards: Free Night Awards Walked-Night Protection by Delay of the Return
content:
**Relocation guarantee clause.** For one of the Free Night Awards coming back from a reservation the hotel relocated, how long the return took changes the walked-night protected price as follows. It is counted in whole calendar days from the date the hotel relocated the reservation to the date of the return:

- more than the long-delay days, 60 days, protect the walked night at the off-peak price of the relocated reservation's category;
- more than the short-delay days, 30 days, but no more than the long-delay days protect it at that category's standard-season price;
- the short-delay days or fewer, 30 days or fewer, protect it at the walked night's own award-chart price, for the category and season recorded on the relocated reservation.

The relocation date is the one on the relocated reservation's Room Reservations record; the date of the return is the date on which the award's return is recorded.

## Figures of the Ashbury Rewards award chart used by the clause

The award chart's standard-season prices by category are those of the Ashbury Rewards award chart; a category's season step is the gap between its neighbouring seasons; its off-peak price is its standard-season price less one season step and its peak-season price its standard-season price plus one season step.

| Category | Standard-season price | Season step | Off-peak price |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 7500 | 2500 | 5000 |
| 2 | 12500 | 2500 | 10000 |
| 3 | 17500 | 2500 | 15000 |
| 4 | 25000 | 5000 | 20000 |
| 5 | 35000 | 5000 | 30000 |
| 6 | 45000 | 5000 | 40000 |
| 7 | 60000 | 10000 | 50000 |
| 8 | 85000 | 15000 | 70000 |

## Boundary days (hypothetical category 6 peak-season night)

| Days from relocation to return | Walked night protected at | Points |
|---|---|---|
| 30 | Its own award-chart price, peak | 50000 |
| 31 | The category's standard-season price | 45000 |
| 60 | The category's standard-season price | 45000 |
| 61 | The category's off-peak price | 40000 |
